prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1321; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle inspected at the shop following a side impact at an intersection. The damage to the driver's side is largely consistent with the impact as described, affecting the front door, rear door, and quarter panel, with associated sill and mirror-housing damage. No prior damage to this vehicle has come to light during the inspection. The repair plan calls for panel replacement, refinishing, and recalibration of the side-mounted sensors. Labor hours submitted for each operation fit the scope of the damage shown, and the parts and charges listed on the invoices show no repeated entries. Recommend approval of the estimate as written.
